source: Schola Europaea – Discovery of the World Syllabus, Primary cycle (P1-P5), réf. 2015-09-D-30-en-3, approuvé en février 2016, en vigueur depuis le 01/09/2016 – objectifs de Year 5 (P5).
note: Objectifs repris du syllabus (en anglais), regroupés en 4 thèmes ; chaque objectif est précédé du nom de son chapitre. « revisions » = objectifs de P4 liés au thème. Pas de « defis » (le niveau suivant est le secondaire). Le chapitre « Puberté » n'est pas repris dans un quiz pour enfants ; il reste en classe. Ont été écartés les objectifs impossibles à évaluer par un quiz (fabriquer un dynamomètre, mener une recherche, présenter).

objectifs: Respiration et circulation – Describe the respiration process, name and function of the main organs
Respiration et circulation – Describe the circulation process, name and function of the main organs
Respiration et circulation – Recognise and describe the connection between respiration and circulation
Respiration et circulation – Develop an awareness of health aspects concerning respiration and circulation (e.g. smoking, allergies)
revisions: Nutrition et digestion – Describe the digestive system and know the names of the main organs

objectifs: Forces et mouvement – Identify how objects and materials may be moved (e.g. pushing, pulling, rollers, gears)
Forces et mouvement – Explore the effect of friction on movement and how it may be used to slow or stop moving objects
Forces et mouvement – Describe how force could be strengthened by the use of levers and gears
Forces et mouvement – Become aware of reverse forces (e.g. balance, weightlessness)
Forces et mouvement – Come to appreciate that gravity is a force
Forces et mouvement – Become aware that objects have weight because of the pull of gravity
Forces et mouvement – Explore how levers may be used to help lift different objects
revisions: L'énergie – Recognise concrete examples of how energy changes from one form to another
L'électricité – Construct a simple electrical circuit

objectifs: L'espace – Know the names and order of the planets in our solar system
L'espace – Describe the main characteristics of the planets and how they orbit the sun
L'espace – Know the order of the different phases of the moon and what causes these phases
Globe, cartes et paysages – Recognise lines of longitude and latitude
Globe, cartes et paysages – Read coordinates (e.g. when using an atlas)
Globe, cartes et paysages – Compare time zones around the world
Globe, cartes et paysages – Describe reliefs of European countries using a map
Globe, cartes et paysages – Describe landscapes from different regions of Europe
Phénomènes naturels – Know the causes and effects of natural phenomena (e.g. volcanoes, earthquakes, storms, floods)
revisions: Climat et météo – Give characteristics of and compare different climatic regions

objectifs: Époques de changement – Become familiar with aspects of an era of change and conflict (e.g. Voyages of Discovery, Reformation, French Revolution, World Wars)
Époques de changement – Recognise ways in which the everyday lives of people changed
Époques de changement – Identify people, organisations and events involved in bringing about change
La construction de l'Union européenne – Understand and describe the reasons for the creation of a European community
La construction de l'Union européenne – Describe the growth of the EU using maps from the various stages of development
La construction de l'Union européenne – Become familiar with and describe some of the EU's achievements (e.g. the euro)
La construction de l'Union européenne – Describe an event and its effect on the development of the EU (e.g. fall of the Berlin Wall)
Les droits de l'homme – Become familiar with the UN Declaration of Human Rights and the UN Global Goals for Sustainable Development (democracy, equality, tolerance)
La dimension européenne – Compare similarities and differences between EU member states with regards to culture (e.g. art, music, national dishes)
revisions: Se repérer dans le temps – Record people and events in the past using simple timelines
Le Moyen Âge – Understand and explain the feudal system
